title: In the Way
setup: Black's king is stranded on h4, so the rook has to deal with the free d-pawn entirely on its own.
hint: Attacking the pawn is not the same as stopping it. Which square does the pawn have to run into?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd6}} plants the rook straight in front of the pawn, and {{d5}} now runs into {{Rxd5+}}. Hit it from the side with {{Rf4}} and White answers {{Rd8}}, defending from behind, after which the pawn walks up the board.
